$comment: The coverage ledger. Every load-bearing claim this system makes about itself names the check that verifies it. audit-system.py reports any claim whose verifier is null or missing from disk. The repo already knew 'skipped is not passed'; this is the generalisation it lacked — UNCHECKED IS NOT PASSED. Every blind spot found on 2026-08-28 was a claim in this shape: asserted, believed, and verified by nothing, while every check that did exist passed.

claims.claim: No value may exist outside tokens.json (the token contract)
claims.how: find_literal_leaks — zero literals above the primitive layer, recursing into composite values

claims.claim: No component may be used that is not in component-index.json (prohibition 1)
claims.how: plants an unindexed component and requires BLOCK; plants an indexed one and requires allow

claims.claim: No user quote may exist outside evidence-ledger.json (prohibition 2)
claims.how: unresolved [E-nnn] in artifacts/ and foundations/ is a blocker
claims.note: PARTIAL — the ledger is empty, so the check has never had a resolvable ID to pass on. Untested in the affirmative.

claims.how: 12 planted violations across raw hex, raw spacing, components, naming and types

claims.claim: The Stop backstop catches what Gate B cannot see (Bash writes)
claims.how: writes a violation via a shell redirect and requires the backstop to report it

claims.note: UNCHECKED, and known-incomplete: settings.json denies Write/Edit on research/sources/** but NOT Bash. Recorded in architecture.md; nothing tests it.

claims.how: check 4b validates every entry; the adapter refuses to write on violation

claims.claim: Every tokens_used reference resolves to a real token
No two component entries share a normalised name (ADR-018)
claims.how: collision guard refuses to write; audit-contracts.py reports independently

claims.claim: Regenerating the component index produces an identical file (ADR-013 link 1)
claims.note: UNCHECKED as a standing test. Verified by hand on 2026-08-28 (byte-identical across three runs) but nothing re-runs it, so drift would be silent.

claims.claim: Light and dark semantic themes carry identical key sets (ADR-001 needs one name per variable mode)
claims.how: symmetry check; the aligner refuses to write unless the sets match exactly

claims.claim: Counts stated in prose match the things they count
claims.note: UNCHECKED. See correction C-010 — four documents drifted (17 ADRs reported as nine, twelve scripts as three). Cross-derivation was done by hand once.

claims.claim: Evidence cited by a tracked document is itself tracked
claims.how: the foundations check errors on scratch/ references
claims.note: PARTIAL — covers design-system/foundations/ only. decisions/ is uncovered; see correction C-011.

claims.claim: Artifacts carry resolvable provenance to a token version
claims.note: UNCHECKED and currently FALSE: every manifest carries tokens_version: null. ADR-013 link 8.

claims.claim: The autonomy ladder graduates and demotes task types on evidence
claims.note: UNCHECKED and unimplemented. Nothing counts clean reviews, so nothing can graduate or be demoted. The ladder is prose.

claims.claim: Work is routed through the agent roster and its gates
claims.note: UNCHECKED and currently FALSE: all 7 registered artifacts record produced_by 'main-session'. The routing table has 39 rows and has never been exercised.
